_doc: Performance budgets enforced by scripts/audit/{bundle-size,asset-budget,build-profile}.ts. Numbers are seeded from today's measurements (build on 2026-05-12) with headroom; tighten as the site stabilizes.

bundle._doc: Gzipped sizes of dist/_astro/*.{css,js} + dist/scripts/*.js. Today CSS total is ~12.3 KB, JS is 528 B.

assets._doc: Raster files in public/. If a PNG/JPG exceeds the threshold, it must have a WebP companion of the same stem or be listed in webpExemptions. og-default.png and logo.png are slated for compression in a follow-up; the SVG variant of the logo already exists.

build._doc: Peak resident set size of pnpm build, in MB. null = report-only (seeded once a CI run measures real value).

runtime._doc: performance.memory.usedJSHeapSize after page load + 5s settle, in MB. Chromium-only.
